summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier), following the seven-step procedure in the spec. Added test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with one parametrized test covering valid forms, the invalid error branches, and a check that the graph's triples are unchanged. Ran pytest on the new test module and test/test_path.py: 39 passed. black, ruff, isort, and mypy are not installed in the shared venv, so they were not run; line lengths were checked by hand (all within 88 columns). Nothing was committed.
